# Usage errors, missing tasks, and forbidden operations fail with useful errors.
! exec weft$exe check
stdout 'missing tasks directory'

exec weft$exe init
exec weft$exe show --help
stdout 'Show a task'
! stderr .+

exitcode 2 list --unknown-option
stderr 'weft list: unknown option "--unknown-option"'
! stdout .+

! exec weft$exe add 'Invalid state' --state someday
stderr 'weft add: invalid state "someday"'

exitcode 1 show 999
stderr 'weft show: task 999 not found'
! exec weft$exe start 999
stderr 'weft start: task 999 not found'
! exec weft$exe done 999
stderr 'weft done: task 999 not found'
! exec weft$exe reopen 999
stderr 'weft reopen: task 999 not found'
! exec weft$exe move 999 todo
stderr 'weft move: task 999 not found'
! exec weft$exe rename 999 'Missing task'
stderr 'weft rename: task 999 not found'
! exec weft$exe reorder 999 --first
stderr 'weft reorder: task 999 not found'
! exec weft$exe meta get 999
stderr 'weft meta: task 999 not found'

exec weft$exe add 'Completed item' --state todo
exec weft$exe done 001
! exec weft$exe reorder 001 --first
stderr 'done tasks keep completion order and cannot be reordered'

exec weft$exe add 'Active item' --state todo
! exec weft$exe reopen 002
stderr 'cannot reopen 002 from todo'

! exec weft$exe meta set 001 id '"custom"'
stderr 'reserved'
